subject: POS Terminal T1 - End-of-Day Settlement Timeout Error
description: Store manager reports that POS Terminal T1 is unable to complete end-of-day settlement. The terminal displays a timeout error message when attempting to reconcile cash and card transactions from today's trading session. Manager has already confirmed that all transactions were processed successfully throughout the day; the issue appears only during the settlement phase. No prior troubleshooting steps have been attempted beyond a single refresh attempt.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and acknowledged. Initial verification confirms POS Terminal T1 is online and responsive. Advised store manager to check network connectivity and restart the settlement process; awaiting update.
